text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.**

Satellite data support approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2021. Most of that area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change.

Determining legality would require information about the cause, applicable rules and any relevant permits or authorizations.
